Additionally, the new law requires manufacturers of internet-connected baby monitors to implement security safeguards against unauthorised access to audio and video streams.
articles.description: Governor Kathy Hochul signed two laws on October 28 barring AI chatbots from harmful interactions with minors, including simulating romantic relationships and promoting self-harm, and requiring security safeguards in internet-connected baby monitors

articles.headline: Crypto exchange platform Binance suffers major cyberattack resulting in asset loss
articles.title: What we know about Binance’s multi-billion-dollar crypto hack | Explained
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange platform Binance experienced a cyberattack on October 29 that resulted in asset losses exceeding six billion dollars. Following warnings from independent crypto trackers, Binance acknowledged reports of a potential security issue on October 30 while assuring users that their funds remained entirely safe. Investigations into the exploit remain ongoing as facts continue to emerge from the incident.
articles.description: While the facts are still emerging, the Binance cyberattack could go down as the largest cryptocurrency hack on record

articles.headline: US, South Korea, and Japan urge complete denuclearization of North Korea
articles.title: US, South Korea, Japan call for ‘complete denuclearisation’ of North Korea
articles.summary: Top diplomats from the United States, South Korea, and Japan reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea during meetings in Atlanta. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun, and Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi called for the full implementation of United Nations Security Council resolutions. The diplomatic push occurs despite speculation regarding potential future talks between Washington and Pyongyang.
articles.description: The joint statement comes as US President Donald Trump seeks a new meeting with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

articles.headline: Oman rescues crew from burning ship as Iran halts tankers in strait
articles.title: Oman rescues 25 from burning ship, Iran halts tankers
articles.summary: Oman's navy rescued 25 crew members from the Panamanian-flagged merchant ship RITI after it was attacked and caught fire on October 30, 2026, according to the Maritime Security Centre. Simultaneously, Iran's Revolutionary Guards reported that three oil tankers were halted in the Strait of Hormuz after encountering incidents. U.S. Central Command chief Brad Cooper stated that American forces had cleared primary transit routes of sea mines.
articles.description: Tehran has restricted maritime traffic through the strait since the West Asia war erupted on February 28 with U.S.-Israeli strikes on the Islamic republic

articles.headline: G20 foreign ministers conclude Atlanta meeting without consensus on key global issues
articles.title: G20 foreign ministers to end Atlanta meeting without consensus on key issues
articles.summary: Top diplomats from the Group of 20 largest economies concluded two days of talks in Atlanta without a joint communique on October 31, 2026. According to attending diplomats, divisions over Russia's war in Ukraine and other global security crises prevented agreement, prompting U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio to issue a chairman's statement instead. The meeting was further strained by European objections to Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov's presence.
articles.description: Divisions over Russia’s war with Ukraine overshadowed the talks, with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio set to release a chairman’s statement instead of a joint communique

articles.headline: US midterms approach as early voting surges and national polls show Democratic lead
articles.title: US midterms: 3 days to go – What latest polls say as early voting surges
articles.summary: With the United States midterm elections approaching on Tuesday, national surveys indicate a Democratic lead while early voter turnout surpasses previous levels. According to an Associated Press analysis, over 43 million Americans cast ballots early. President Donald Trump scheduled weekend rallies in Iowa and Kansas to mobilise supporters, while various candidates concluded their campaigns across multiple states.
articles.description: More than 43 million Americans have voted early as Democrats lead opinion polls and Trump prepares for final rallies.

articles.headline: Madras High Court rules on court fee refunds in civil settlements
articles.title: Litigants will not be entitled to refund of court fees if disputes get settled out of court after commencement of trial, rules Madras High Court
articles.summary: The Madras High Court ruled that civil litigants cannot receive court fee refunds if their disputes settle out of court after trials begin. Justice P.B. Balaji dismissed two civil revision petitions while departing from a 2021 Supreme Court precedent. The court emphasized that statutory provisions and earlier rulings restrict fee refunds to pre-trial alternative dispute resolution referrals to protect public finances.
articles.description: Justice P.B. Balaji refuses to follow Supreme Court’s 2017 verdict in M.C. Subramaniam’s case and instead follows the top court’s 2010 judgment in Afcons Infrastructure case

articles.headline: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw launches Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express
articles.title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express flagged off by Railway Minister
articles.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw flagged off the Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express on November 1, establishing a new overnight service connecting India tech capital with its financial hub. Operating six days a week, the train connects Sir M. Visvesvaraya Terminal in Bengaluru to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus in Mumbai while passing through Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Maharashtra. Vaishnaw also announced upcoming services towards Hubballi and Mangaluru to further improve regional rail connectivity.
articles.description: The overnight service will connect Bengaluru with Mumbai via Anantapur, Raichur, Kalaburagi, Solapur and Pune, improving connectivity across three States

articles.headline: India defeats Malaysia 4-2 at Asian Champions Trophy after Harmanpreet hat-trick
articles.title: Asian Champions Trophy: Harmanpreet’s hat-trick helps India down Malaysia
articles.summary: Captain Harmanpreet Singh scored a hat-trick to help India secure a 4-2 victory against Malaysia at the Asian Champions Trophy. The match at the Olympian Surjeet Stadium left India as the only unbeaten side in the tournament. Malaysia tested the hosts before falling behind, while Japan and Korea also secured their places in the upcoming tournament semifinals.
articles.description: Japan and Korea join the two teams in the semifinals

articles.headline: Helicopter operators threaten service suspension over new two pilot mandate
articles.title: Char Dham helicopter operators threaten to halt services over DGCA's two-pilot rule
articles.summary: Helicopter operators in Uttarakhand threatened to suspend Char Dham charter services starting November 2, 2026, protesting a new directive by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation and the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority requiring two pilots per sortie. The mandate followed a fatal helicopter crash in Joshimath. Operators argue the rule creates unsustainable financial burdens and have questioned the regulatory response regarding existing hazards.
articles.description: Operators say mandate brought in following Joshimath crash not financially viable; accuse authorities of ignoring concerns over safety hazards, particularly drones and paragliding activity along flying routes

articles.headline: Amit Shah promises Uniform Civil Code in Uttar Pradesh if BJP wins
articles.title: Uniform Civil Code in U.P. if BJP voted to power again: Amit Shah
articles.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced that the Bharatiya Janata Party will implement a Uniform Civil Code in Uttar Pradesh if the party wins the 2027 Assembly election. Speaking at a state executive meeting, Mr. Shah praised Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath for governance and challenged opposition leaders to a parliamentary debate regarding voter revision controversies, while accusing the Samajwadi Party of disrupting legislative proceedings.
articles.description: Amit Shah challenges Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav to a debate on the special intensive revision in Parliament, but says they just wanted to create a ruckus

articles.headline: Michigan Democrat Haley Stevens endorses Republican Mike Rogers in Senate race
articles.title: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat escalates
articles.summary: Haley Stevens endorsed Republican candidate Mike Rogers in the Michigan US Senate contest on Sunday. The endorsement followed an escalating dispute with Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed after a public clash over a campaign advertisement. Stevens made a surprise appearance alongside Rogers at a church, stating she no longer belonged in El-Sayed campaign. The Senate race is considered one of the tightest contests in the midterm elections determining control of Congress.
articles.description: Haley Stevens, a former congresswomen who lost out on the Democratic nomination to Abdul El-Sayed, endorses his opponent days before the vote.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh municipal elections conclude peacefully amid minor clashes in Pulivendula
articles.title: Andhra Pradesh civic polls largely peaceful; Jagan demands repoll in Pulivendula after clashes
articles.summary: Elections to urban local bodies in Andhra Pradesh concluded on November 1, 2026, with an overall voter turnout of forty eight percent. While voting was mostly peaceful, incidents of stone pelting and vehicle torching occurred in Pulivendula. YSR Congress Party president Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy demanded a repoll, alleging electoral malpractices. State Election Commissioner Anil Chandra Punetha stated that field reports and police FIRs were currently being reviewed.
articles.description: Polling across 13 municipal corporations and 79 municipalities and nagar panchayats ends amid sporadic violence. The SEC puts the overall polling percentage at 48.03 by 3 p.m., reports 275 FIRs in connection with 40 incidents and says repolling, if required, will be held on November 2

articles.headline: New South Wales police deploy armed response command across Sydney
articles.title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
articles.summary: Heavily armed officers have begun patrolling Sydney streets and major public venues in New South Wales following the December mass shooting at Bondi Beach. The specialist unit aims to deter major threats and protect residents, though responses are mixed. Jewish groups welcomed the increased protection, while Amnesty International expressed concern over potential militarisation and the impact on peaceful protests.
articles.description: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.

articles.headline: Spain train disaster threatens Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez reelection chances
articles.title: Spain train disaster clouds Sánchez chances of re-election
articles.summary: A high-speed train collision in central Spain resulted in 69 recovered bodies, severely damaging public confidence in the rail network and Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez ahead of a snap general election. Transport Minister Oscar Puente defended the infrastructure and blamed human error, while opposition parties called for his resignation. The tragedy compounds existing political crises for Sanchez, whose party trails behind the centre-right People's Party in recent polls.
articles.description: The Spanish PM is hit by a succession of crises just weeks before a snap general election.

articles.headline: Cyclonic storm Murasu approaches coast bringing heavy rainfall to southern states
articles.title: Storm ‘Murasu’ to bring very heavy rain over north Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: Cyclonic Storm Murasu moved west-northwestwards over the Bay of Bengal on November 1, 2026, and is projected to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm before crossing the south Andhra Pradesh coast between November 2 and November 3. The Regional Meteorological Centre forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall accompanied by thunderstorms and lightning across several districts in Tamil Nadu and neighboring regions over a multi day period.
articles.description: Isolated places over Chennai, Chengalpattu, Kancheepuram, Ranipet and Nilgiris districts are likely to get heavy rainfall on Monday, November 2; Chennai District Collector S. Malathi Helen announced holiday for schools on account of heavy rains

articles.headline: Opposition leaders demand disqualification of independent MLCs in Bihar
articles.title: RJD and JSP call for disqualification of independent MLCs who ‘joined’ BJP
articles.summary: Rashtriya Janata Dal MP Manoj Jha and Jan Suraaj Party representative Kumar Saurabh urged the acting chairman of the Bihar Legislative Council to disqualify two independent members. They cited India anti-defection law after the Bharatiya Janata Party claimed the legislators had joined their party. Both independent members denied the formal affiliation, claiming they only offered backing.
articles.description: The Bihar Bharatiya Janata Party issued a press statement saying both had joined the party; when a controversy erupted both MLCs said they have not joined the party but are supporting the BJP

articles.headline: Trump tells voters to send El-Sayed ‘back to where he came from’
articles.title: Trump tells voters to send El-Sayed ‘back to where he came from’
articles.description: Speaking at a campaign rally, Donald Trump told voters to send Michigan’s Abdul El-Sayed ‘back to where he came from’.

articles.headline: University of Cambridge researcher killed in Spanish train crash
articles.title: University of Cambridge scientist among those who died in Spanish train crash
articles.summary: Dr Marta Shahbazi died when her train collided with another near Urda, south of Madrid, killing 69 people. The University of Cambridge scientist was travelling to collect an award for scientific excellence in human embryos and cell biology. Colleagues at the Medical Research Council Laboratory of Molecular Biology paid tribute to the mother of two following the disaster.
articles.description: Marta Shahbazi was an "inspiring, talented and passionate scientist", says the laboratory where she worked.

articles.headline: Bangladesh workers clash with police in protests over low pay
articles.title: Bangladesh workers clash with police in protests over low pay
articles.description: Dozens of garment workers in Bangladesh clashed with police in the capital Dhaka.

articles.headline: West Bengal government provides jobs for families affected by political violence
articles.title: West Bengal government notifies jobs for kin of those killed in political violence
articles.summary: The West Bengal government issued a notification on November 1, 2026, offering Group D government employment to one dependent family member of individuals killed in political violence since 2001. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced the initiative, which includes an income ceiling of 50,000 rupees and requires district magistrate screening of applicant documentation.
articles.description: The notification provides a cut off date from 2001 onwards; families of victims of political violence in the past 25 years can apply for government jobs

articles.headline: India protesters march with 1km banner of deleted voters’ names
articles.title: India protesters march with 1km banner of deleted voters’ names
articles.description: Protesters in New Delhi carried a one-kilometre banner bearing the names of people removed from India’s voter rolls.

articles.headline: Bhutan dedicates Buddhist stupa to Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi
articles.title: Bhutan builds 108 stupas in 9 hours, dedicates No. 76 to PM Modi
articles.summary: Bhutanese King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuk dedicated a Buddhist stupa to Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on November 1, 2026, honoring India's support for the Gelephu Mindfulness City project. Approximately 40,000 volunteers constructed 108 steel-framed stupas along the Mau Chhu River in nine hours, establishing a spiritual foundation for the planned economic hub.
articles.description: King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuk says gesture recognises India’s steadfast support for realisation of Gelephu Mindfulness City

articles.headline: Suvendu Adhikari criticises Mamata Banerjee over Matua community
articles.title: West Bengal CM promises CAA certificates to 2.5 lakh Matuas by end of 2026
articles.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari accused his predecessor, Mamata Banerjee, of dividing the Matua community and opposing the Citizenship Amendment Act. Speaking at the International Matua Gosai Convention 2026 in Thakurnagar, Adhikari asserted that the previous administration failed to support the Scheduled Caste community, which originates from present-day Bangladesh and follows a 19th-century social reform movement.
articles.description: During his first visit to Thakurbari in North 24 Parganas after taking up the office of Chief Minister, Suvendu Adhikari says West Bengal would have turned into Bangladesh had the BJP not come to power in 2026

articles.headline: Coal India production rises 19 percent in October following monsoon recovery
articles.title: Coal India’s production increases 19% as mining recovers after monsoon slump
articles.summary: Coal India reported a nineteen percent increase in coal production to reach 67.2 million tonnes in October, according to the Kolkata-headquartered miner. Supplies to the power sector and overall shipments both scaled record highs, reaching 57.1 million tonnes and 70.3 million tonnes respectively. The growth reflects mining activity recovering from monsoonal disruptions, cyclones, and unseasonal rainfall while meeting rising energy demands.
articles.description: In a statement, the Coal India said, “The achievement assumes greater significance in view of the need to augment coal stocks at thermal power plants amid rising power demand.”

articles.headline: Russian security forces detain teenager over alleged Moscow attack plot
articles.title: Russia detains minor over alleged Moscow attack plot after US warning
articles.summary: Russian authorities detained a teenager suspected of planning an attack at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve in Moscow. The Federal Security Service stated the arrest followed a warning from the United States embassy regarding a credible threat. Investigators discovered tactical clothing and terrorism-related searches on the suspect's phone after closing the park temporarily.
articles.description: Russian authorities say a US tip-off helped them identify teenager suspected of planning attack at a Moscow park.

articles.headline: Odisha considers explosives for landslide rescue as cyclone threat approaches
articles.title: Odisha short of equipment, may use explosives to rescue landslide victims
articles.summary: Five people were killed and ten others remain missing following landslides triggered by Cyclone Arnab in Odisha. Rescue teams from the Odisha Disaster Rapid Action Force and National Disaster Response Force have been working for fifty hours in Gidipabali village. Officials are now considering controlled blasting with railway engineers to clear massive boulders while preparing for Cyclonic Storm Murasu.
articles.description: With no road access, officials are looking for cranes and earthmovers; they are also seeking the assistance of engineers with expertise in controlled blasting to break up boulders

articles.headline: Bangladesh establishes wage board as garment workers continue violent protests
articles.title: Bangladesh forms wage board as garment workers keep up protests
articles.summary: Bangladesh established a new board to review minimum wages for garment workers as thousands continued demonstrations in industrial hubs around Dhaka. Labour Minister Ariful Haque Choudhury announced the board during a news conference, urging workers to return amid clashes with police using tear gas. Workers are demanding over 30,000 taka monthly to combat inflation and rising household expenses.
articles.description: The garment sector is the backbone of Bangladesh's export-driven economy, employing millions of workers and generating the bulk of the country's foreign earnings

articles.headline: Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan urges Keralam to reverse insurance premium hike
articles.title: Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan asks Keralam govt. to reverse premium hike for NoRKA Care insurance scheme
articles.summary: The leader of the opposition Pinarayi Vijayan urged the state government to lower the hiked premium for the NoRKA Care insurance scheme. He stated that family floater policy rates surged from 13411 rupees up to 77773 rupees, placing an unbearable financial burden on ordinary expatriates and senior citizens. He criticized the administration for refusing assembly discussions and allegedly surrendering to private insurance company interests.
articles.description: The premium for a ‘family floater’ policy (with a coverage of ₹5 lakh) has been hiked from ₹13,411 to a range between ₹35,664 and ₹77,773, he says

articles.headline: IAF Chief Dixit prioritizes squadron strength and self-reliance
articles.title: New IAF chief Ashutosh Dixit outlines ‘VAYU’ priorities, vows to boost combat readiness
articles.summary: Newly-appointed Indian Air Force Chief Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit stated on November 1, 2026, that restoring fighter squadron strength and advancing self-reliance are top priorities. Speaking a day after taking charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff, he outlined his VAYU vision focusing on vigilance, self-reliance, tactical innovation, and tri-services unity. He emphasized that the force must adapt to modern threats including drones and artificial intelligence.
articles.description: Prioritises indigenous capabilities, joint operations and restoration of IAF’s sanctioned combat strength

articles.headline: Private plantation companies hold thousands of hectares in Chalakudy without expiry dates.
articles.title: Over 3,500 hectares of land leased to Harrison Malayalam, Cochin Malabar Estates without specified tenure, reveals RTI reply
articles.summary: Official records released under the Right to Information Act reveal that Harrison Malayalam Limited and Cochin Malabar Estates hold over 3,500 hectares of land in the Chalakudy Forest Division under leases dating back to 1911 without specified expiry dates. The documents, provided by State Public Information Officer Shijo C. Kurian, also detail expired leases and land used for various public utility projects across the region.
articles.description: RTI disclosures from Chalakudy Forest Division reveal land allotments dating back to 1911; Plantation Corporation’s 4,261-hectare lease expired in 2017

articles.headline: Mahadev betting app promoter Sourabh Chandrakar extradited from Oman to India
articles.title: Mahadev betting syndicate ‘kingpin’ extradited from Oman
articles.summary: Sourabh Chandrakar, promoter of the illegal Mahadev Online Book betting app, was extradited to India from Oman on November 1, 2026, according to a Central Bureau of Investigation spokesperson. Located by the Royal Oman Police following an Interpol Red Corner Notice, Chandrakar faces charges in cases filed by the Central Bureau of Investigation and the Enforcement Directorate regarding an alleged 6,000-crore-rupee scam.
articles.description: CBI says it secured extradition of Sourabh Chandrakar, who had been arrested by police in Oman following an Interpol Red Corner Notice

articles.headline: Cheranalloor accident victim's daughter files petition alleging judge tampered with evidence
articles.title: Cheranalloor accident: petition by victim’s daughter alleges judge tampered with evidence
articles.summary: Bhadrakeerthi R.J., whose father Jayabalakrishnan was killed in an October 25, 2026, collision involving a luxury car reportedly driven by an additional district judge's minor son, petitioned the Cheranalloor station house officer. She alleged the judge destroyed evidence at the scene, interfered with the police probe, and violated norms, requesting a comprehensive criminal investigation into evidence tampering.
articles.description: In her petition, she has alleged that the Additional District Judge, who owned the car, destroyed evidence at the accident spot and tried to deflect the probe

articles.headline: Israel's election confirms Prime Minister Netanyahu's bloc lost its parliamentary majority.
articles.title: Difficult negotiations lie ahead in Israel after Netanyahu's bloc lost its parliamentary majority
articles.summary: Israel's final election results released on October 30, 2026, confirmed that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc secured 53 seats in the October 27 election, losing its majority in the 120-seat Knesset. The main opposition won 48 seats while Arab-led parties took 19. President Isaac Herzog will task someone with forming a government after results are submitted on November 4, amid controversy over unproven allegations of electoral interference.
articles.description: The election results still need to be certified and submitted to the President next Wednesday (November 4, 2026)

articles.headline: Donald Trump criticises former lawyer Alina Habba Mildon over lucrative banker deal
articles.title: Trump slams ex-lawyer’s $50m deal with pardoned banker’s family
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump criticized former lawyer Alina Habba Mildon on November 7, 2026, regarding a fifty-million-dollar contract she signed with the family of pardoned Venezuelan banker Julio Herrera Velutini. Habba Mildon reportedly signed the deal while serving as acting United States attorney for New Jersey before Trump subsequently granted Herrera a full presidential pardon in January.
articles.description: Alina Habba Mildon signed lucrative contract while working at the Justice Department, before Trump pardoned the banker.

articles.headline: JERUSALEM DAILY: Israel continues siege and arrests in Hebron
articles.title: JERUSALEM DAILY: Israel continues siege and arrests in Hebron
articles.description: Israel’s siege on Hebron is on its 10th day and its attacks on Gaza continue.

articles.headline: Serbian authorities arrest criminal police directorate head Marko Kricak over abuse of office
articles.title: Serbia arrests police chief over abuse of office allegations
articles.summary: Serbian authorities arrested criminal police directorate head Marko Kricak and anti-organised crime commander Bosko Sekulovic on November 1, 2026, following allegations of abuse of office and providing false evidence against former Belgrade police chief Veselin Milic. Belgrade chief prosecutor Nenad Stefanovic stated the arrests are unrelated to recent legislative elections won by the student-backed Student List movement.
articles.description: Belgrade's chief prosecutor says arrest of Marko Kricak 'has no link' to elections that saw Aleksandar Vucic step down.

articles.headline: U.S., South Korea and Japan reaffirm complete denuclearisation of North Korea
articles.title: U.S., South Korea, Japan vow ‘complete’ North Korea’s denuclearisation
articles.summary: Diplomats from the United States, South Korea and Japan reiterated their commitment to complete denuclearisation during discussions held on October 30, 2026, in Atlanta. The meeting took place amid ongoing speculation regarding potential talks between Washington and Pyongyang, while North Korea continues to reject disarmament efforts and maintains its status as a nuclear-armed state.
articles.description: Speculation is mounting over a potential meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong Un at next month’s APEC summit in China, with Mr. Trump making repeated overtures to Pyongyang for nuclear talks

articles.headline: Russia’s Novaya Gazeta ‘killed off’ after murders, arrests and pressure
articles.title: Russia’s Novaya Gazeta ‘killed off’ after murders, arrests and pressure
articles.description: Russia’s most prominent investigative newspaper is closing, with staff accusing the government of killing it off.

articles.headline: Tata Motors acquires controlling stake in Iveco Group for 4.32 billion dollars
articles.title: Tata Motors says Iveco is now part of group; Chandrasekaran appointed Chairperson
articles.summary: Tata Motors Ltd. completed the voluntary tender offer acquisition of Iveco Group N.V. by securing approximately 89.42% of its common shares for about $4.32 billion. Led by Tata Group Chairman N. Chandrasekaran, the transaction involves executive board changes across both companies, including Chandrasekaran taking over as Chairperson of Iveco Group N.V. The final settlement of shares is scheduled for November 13, 2026.
articles.description: The acquisition is valued at approximately $4.32 billion (₹42,561 crore)

articles.headline: Ebola death toll in Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds five thousand
articles.title: Ebola death toll in DR Congo passes 5,000
articles.summary: Government data released on October 31, 2026, indicates that the death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed five thousand. Authorities are struggling to control the outbreak caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, which has infected over ten thousand people and spread to neighboring African countries, prompting travel restrictions.
articles.description: Authorities ​are struggling to find a way to control the ⁠outbreak, with no approved treatments or vaccines.

articles.headline: Nara Lokesh vows stringent action following school chainsaw attack
articles.title: Lokesh vows stringent action after chainsaw attack on Class X student in Raptadu
articles.summary: Human Resources Development and Information Technology Minister Nara Lokesh visited injured student Gopika in Bengaluru on Sunday and promised strict punishment for those responsible. The Class X student was assaulted with a chainsaw inside a classroom at Raptadu Zilla Parishad High School on Saturday. The Education Department has deployed mental health counsellors to support traumatised students.
articles.description: HRD and IT Minister visits Gopika at Bengaluru hospital, assures family of full government support; says next 48 hours are critical; 20 counsellors deployed to help traumatised classmates

articles.headline: Hundreds evacuated from Melania-brokered ceasefire town of Oleshky
articles.title: Hundreds evacuated from Melania-brokered ceasefire town of Oleshky
articles.description: Hundreds have been evacuated from Russia-occupied Oleshky under a localised ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump.

articles.headline: GSLV places navigation satellite NVS-03 into orbit
articles.title: GSLV places next-generation navigation satellite NVS-03 into orbit
articles.summary: The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle launched the NVS-03 satellite from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota on October 30, 2026, according to the Indian Space Research Organisation. The 2250 kilogram satellite is the third in the next-generation navigation system designed to provide continuity of navigation services for the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System series.
articles.description: The NVS-03, with a mission life of 12 years, is expected to restore the functioning of the NavIC constellation; satellite carries an indigenous atomic clock, along with procured atomic clocks

articles.headline: Energy department directs utilities to prepare for incoming Cyclone Murasu
articles.title: Power utilities told to brace for Cyclone Murasu
articles.summary: Special Chief Secretary for Energy K. Vijayanand directed power utilities on November 1, 2026, to implement foolproof precautionary measures to protect electricity infrastructure ahead of Cyclone Murasu. Officials warned that a depression over the Bay of Bengal would intensify into a severe cyclonic storm, threatening coastal districts with strong winds and heavy rainfall. Authorities have positioned equipment and manpower in vulnerable areas for rapid restoration work.
articles.description: Special Chief Secretary directs officials to stock essential materials and position manpower and machinery in vulnerable areas to ensure speedy restoration of power supply

articles.headline: Man dies after finance agents allegedly kick his motorcycle in Nelamangala
articles.title: Bengaluru: Man dies after loan recovery agents knock him off moving motorcycle in Nelamangala
articles.summary: A thirty nine year old man named Murali died at Victoria Hospital in Bengaluru on October 31, 2026, after finance company recovery agents allegedly kicked his moving motorcycle on October 28. The victim was attempting to ride away from the agents who sought to seize his vehicle over unpaid loan instalments. Nelamangala Rural police registered a case and formed a special team to trace and arrest the three suspects.
articles.description: Accusing the recovery agents of being directly responsible for her husband’s death, Lalitha and other family members demanded action against those involved.

articles.headline: German ministers vow strict penalties after Frankfurt riots injure over 100 police
articles.title: German ministers pledge tough action after rioters damage stores in Frankfurt
articles.summary: German officials threatened severe consequences after violent protests in Frankfurt damaged seventeen shops and injured over one hundred police officers. Demonstrations organized by the group Gen Z takes charge turned chaotic on October 31, 2026. Authorities deployed 1300 officers and arrested 54 individuals, predominantly young German nationals with migrant backgrounds, according to Hesse interior minister Roman Poseck and federal interior minister Alexander Dobrindt.
articles.description: Frankfurt became the hot spot for ⁠violent protests after tens of thousands of demonstrators took to the streets of dozens of German cities during the day to demand better education ‌and lower living costs

articles.headline: Somali pirates seize Iranian fishing vessel carrying 23 people in Indian Ocean
articles.title: Somali pirates seize Iranian fishing vessel, raising fears of attacks on cargo ships
articles.summary: Somali pirates hijacked the Iranian fishing vessel Azini on October 29, 2026, carrying 21 crew members and two security guards. The Maritime Security Centre Indian Ocean warned that the ship could serve as a mother ship for further attacks. This seizure compounds regional maritime dangers already disrupted by the ongoing war involving Iran, Houthi threats, and a broader resurgence of piracy off the coast of Somalia.
articles.description: The Azini was hijacked on October 29 between the coastal towns of Bandar Bayla and Hafun in northeastern Somalia, a maritime security officer with the Puntland Maritime Police Force said

articles.headline: Protest slogans and waste litter central Delhi following political rally at Ramlila Maidan
articles.title: ‘Vote chor’ graffiti, littered roads, and a muddy ‘catwalk’ at Ramlila Maidan after INDIA bloc rally
articles.summary: Streets and walls in central Delhi displayed spray-painted political slogans, discarded plastic waste, and debris following a rally by the INDIA bloc on November 1, 2026. Protest participants navigated muddy grounds and waterlogged patches at Ramlila Maidan caused by recent rainfall. Meanwhile, waste collectors utilized the event to gather recyclable plastic bottles from Minto Road and Jawaharlal Nehru Marg for resale.
articles.description: Waste-collectors, some of whom participated in the protest, gathered the discarded plastic bottles near the protest site; rain-soaked, waterlogged stretches forced protesters to tread carefully through the venue

articles.headline: Morocco welcomes expiration of United Nations mission mandate in disputed Western Sahara
articles.title: Why is Morocco celebrating the defeat of a UN resolution on Western Sahara?
articles.summary: Morocco welcomed the defeat of a US-drafted resolution after Russia vetoed the extension of the United Nations mission in Western Sahara, causing its mandate to expire on November 1, 2026. The mission, established in 1991 to monitor a ceasefire and hold a self-determination referendum, faced deadlock over Washington proposals favoring Moroccan autonomy plans. Algeria and the Polisario Front expressed regret over the outcome of the Security Council vote.
articles.description: Mandate expires for UN mission tasked to monitor 1991 truce and hold a referendum in the disputed territory.

articles.headline: Poland’s president joins protest amid constitutional crisis at top court
articles.title: Poland’s president joins protest amid constitutional crisis at top court
articles.description: Poland’s president has cut short a trip to Senegal, joining protesters facing off with police.

articles.headline: Foreign portfolio investors withdraw Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities in October
articles.title: FPIs pull out ₹34,843 crore from Indian equities in October, but turn net buyers end of the month
articles.summary: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities in October, marking the second consecutive month of heavy outflows driven by concerns over higher crude oil prices and global interest rates, according to data from Central Depository Services Limited. Despite the monthly decline, foreign investors turned net buyers towards the end of the month, infusing approximately Rs 6,300 crore between October 26 and October 30.
articles.description: The recent improvement in flows signals a shift in near term sentiment, but one week of buying does not necessarily indicate a sustained reversal, market experts say

articles.headline: Karnataka government considers official recognition for state flag
articles.title: Karnataka thinking of officially recognising Kannada flag: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar
articles.summary: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar announced that the Karnataka government intends to discuss officially recognizing the Kannada flag during the upcoming winter legislature session in Belagavi starting November 30, 2026. Speaking during Rajyothsava celebrations, Shivakumar stated that authorities will explore legal options to adopt the flag without violating national regulations while planning awareness programmes across state institutions.
articles.description: The State government will also issue an order enabling private institutions to fly the Kannada flag. It is also contemplating mandating the flying of the Kannada flag in institutions supported by the government

articles.headline: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu loses parliamentary majority after elections
articles.title: Israel election: When will government be formed, who will lead it?
articles.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu lost his coalition parliamentary majority following legislative elections held on October 27, leaving the 120-seat Knesset without a clear governing bloc. President Isaac Herzog must task an incoming Knesset member with forming a government by November 11, with potential arrangements ranging from a national unity government to minority coalitions or renewed elections if negotiations fail.
articles.description: President Herzog must tap candidate to form new government by November 11, with fraught negotiations likely to follow.

articles.headline: Blockchain analytics firms identify North Korean hackers behind Binance cryptocurrency heist
articles.title: Why North Korea's 'elite' hackers are the prime suspect in major Binance hack
articles.summary: Two blockchain analytics firms, TRM Labs and Chainalysis, have attributed the massive $6.3 billion hack of cryptocurrency exchange Binance to the North Korean state-backed Lazarus Group, also known as TraderTraitor. Investigators state that attackers compromised Binance systems to automatically transfer funds. While Binance reports that approximately 80% of the stolen assets have been successfully secured, the incident highlights escalating cyber threats.
articles.description: If the accusations are true, the record-making heist shows how powerful suspected North Korean hackers have become.

articles.headline: Irish European athletics champion Ciara Mageean passes away aged 34
articles.title: Ireland’s European athletics champion Ciara Mageean dies aged 34
articles.summary: Irish middle-distance runner Ciara Mageean died at age 34 after battling advanced bowel cancer, her family announced in a statement posted on Instagram. The Portaferry native, who won the 1,500 meters gold medal at the 2024 European Athletics Championships in Rome, passed away following a career that included representing Ireland at two Olympic Games and setting multiple national records.
articles.description: Mageean, runner who competed at two Olympic Games, lost her battle with cancer a year after revealing her diagnosis.

articles.headline: External affairs minister criticises global energy market disruptions caused by sanctions and chokepoints
articles.title: India slams global energy disruptions through sanctions, chokepoints
articles.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar strongly condemned deliberate disruptions in global oil supplies during the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta. Addressing U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and international delegates, Mr. Jaishankar stated that sanctions and chokepoints are being used as calculated strategies to hold energy prices hostage. He emphasised the severe impact on low-income countries and called for predictable energy markets.
articles.description: The Minister emphasised that continuous distortions of energy markets through obstacles, sanctions and chokepoints were happening with increasing frequency, greater complexity and wider impact

articles.headline: Akasa Air extends suspension of flights to Jeddah and Riyadh until late November
articles.title: India's flight disruptions to Saudi Arabia continue amid security concerns
articles.summary: Akasa Air extended the suspension of its services to Jeddah until November 18 and to Riyadh until November 30 amid ongoing security concerns in Saudi Arabia. The disruptions follow previous announcements by Air India and Air India Express halting flights to several Saudi cities until November 14, following recent attacks on civilian and critical infrastructure attributed to Yemen Houthi rebels.
articles.description: The flight disruptions have continued amid attacks on civilian and critical infrastructure in Saudi Arabia, including airports

articles.headline: Delegates at Yerevan summit reach agreement on biodiversity action plan
articles.title: Global nature talks reach deal but money remains an issue
articles.summary: Delegates from nearly 200 countries meeting in Yerevan successfully negotiated the key elements of a new biodiversity action plan following prolonged discussions. Environment advocates welcomed the agreement despite widespread warnings that nations are severely falling behind on targets set during the 2022 framework. Participants highlighted that insufficient funding and ongoing environmental subsidies remain major obstacles to global conservation efforts.
articles.description: Countries have been trying to get a global agreement to halt nature decline back on track.

articles.headline: Domestic passenger vehicle dispatches exceed five lakh units in October
articles.title: Domestic PV dispatches cross five-lakh units mark in October on strong festive demand
articles.summary: Domestic passenger vehicle wholesales reached an estimated 5.25 to 5.3 lakh units in October, surpassing the five-lakh mark due to robust festive demand and original equipment manufacturers stocking dealers ahead of peak festive deliveries. Major automakers including Maruti Suzuki, Hyundai Motor India, and Mahindra and Mahindra reported significant year-on-year growth, building on momentum from previous goods and services tax rate reductions and positive macroeconomic factors.
articles.description: Domestic passenger vehicle wholesales in October are estimated in the range of 5.25-5.3 lakh units, against 4.6 lakh units in October 2025; this should represent growth of around 13-15% year-on-year despite a high base in the year-ago period.

articles.headline: European Space Agency reveals starquakes and Milky Way chemical map
articles.title: Explained | What is the Gaia space mission and what has it revealed about the Milky Way?
articles.summary: The European Space Agency published data from its Gaia probe on June 17, 2022, detailing 1.8 billion stars. Findings include starquakes on stellar surfaces and a comprehensive chemical map showing the age, mass, and metal content of millions of stars. The mission also provided new information regarding binary systems, asteroids, quasars, and exoplanets across the Milky Way galaxy.
articles.description: The new data released by the European Space Agency’s Gaia mission has revealed the surprise phenomena of ‘starquakes’—massive tsunami-like movements on the surface of stars

articles.headline: Michigan Senate race between Abdul El-Sayed and Mike Rogers
articles.title: Michigan race: All you need to know about Abdul El-Sayed v Mike Rogers
articles.summary: Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed and Republican nominee Mike Rogers are competing in a high-profile United States Senate race in Michigan. The contest attracts international attention and significant spending, focusing on party control of the chamber, progressive policies, and foreign policy stances regarding Israel, while addressing community concerns and local political representation.
articles.description: Al Jazeera examines the crucial US Senate race in Michigan, including candidate positions and largest spenders.

articles.headline: Central Crime Branch links fake Siddaramaiah sting video to Kumaraswamy residence
articles.title: CCB probe into fake Siddaramaiah sting video points to Kumaraswamy’s Delhi residence; two aides absconding
articles.summary: Central Crime Branch investigators probing a fabricated sting video targeting former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah traced a device to Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy official residence in New Delhi. Police arrested freelance social media influencer Ritesh Pandey while two associates remain absconding. Authorities issued notices to the suspects as financial and digital investigations continue.
articles.description: The CCB has also found that the mobile phone used for uploading the video was purchased in Karol Bagh, Delhi, specifically for the alleged operation

articles.headline: Indian teams win titles at inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship
articles.title: India reigns supreme in Commonwealth kabaddi championship
articles.summary: India secured both the men and women division titles at the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship held at the Veer Savarkar Sports Complex on November 1, 2026. The women's team defeated Uganda 35-15, propelled by strong performances from Sakshi and Anu Sen, while the men's squad triumphed 54-20 against Sri Lanka behind stellar scoring from Aditya Shinde.

articles.headline: French student group announces restart of high school blockades
articles.title: French school blockades to restart from Monday: student group
articles.summary: High school blockades will resume across France on Monday as student leaders claim government proposals fail to address deteriorating learning conditions. Pierre Sourzat, head of the Lyceens group, stated that official measures are insufficient following weeks of protests and nationwide demonstrations. President Emmanuel Macron has urged students to return to classes calmly.
articles.description: France's protest movement against soaring prices emerged from weeks of demonstrations by high school students protesting deteriorating learning conditions and inequality

articles.headline: Commercial LPG and aviation turbine fuel prices increased across India
articles.title: Commercial LPG prices hiked ₹10/cylinder; ATF hiked ₹1.37/litre
articles.summary: Commercial liquefied petroleum gas cylinder prices increased by approximately 10 rupees on November 1, 2026, marking the third consecutive monthly price hike ahead of the festive season and bringing the cost of a cylinder in Delhi to 2,820 rupees. Simultaneously, aviation turbine fuel prices were raised by 1.37 rupees to reach 138.5 rupees per litre. These increases follow previous adjustments implemented across the country throughout September and October.
articles.description: The price of Aviation Turbine Fuel was also hiked by ₹1.37 per litre. It now costs ₹138.5 per litre

articles.headline: Senegal kicks off the Youth Games 2026
articles.title: Senegal kicks off the Youth Games 2026
articles.description: Senegal kicks off the Youth Games 2026

articles.headline: India reports 5.83 percent decline in August coal imports driven by higher production.
articles.title: India’s coal imports decline 5.83% in August
articles.summary: Government data shows that India imported 104.57 million tonnes of coal in August, marking a 5.83 percent decrease from the previous year due to rising domestic output and reduced overseas shipments. The power sector saw a significant drop in blending imports, while coking coal shipments for the steel industry also declined as the Union Coal Ministry emphasized strengthening domestic supply chains.
articles.description: According to a statement from the Coal Ministry, the decline was primarily led by the power sector whose imports during the reported period declined 6.4% overall.

articles.headline: Yamaha withdraws MotoGP team from upcoming Qatar race
articles.title: Yamaha pulls out of Qatar MotoGP over ‘situation in the Middle East’
articles.summary: Japanese manufacturer Yamaha pulled its team from next weekend's Qatar Grand Prix on Sunday, citing ongoing company travel restrictions regarding the Middle East. The MotoGP Group expressed disappointment over the absence, noting that safety assurances had been provided. The remainder of the racing grid confirmed their participation for the event at Lusail International Circuit.
articles.description: MotoGP says Yamaha's lack of participation at next weekend's event in Lusail 'carries sporting implications'.

articles.headline: J.P. Nadda criticises opposition rally and defends democratic governance
articles.title: Nadda terms INDIA bloc rally against CEC a ‘foolish and designed drama’
articles.summary: Union Minister J.P. Nadda condemned the opposition INDIA bloc protest in New Delhi as a designed drama meant to subvert democracy. Speaking to reporters on November 1, 2026, the senior Bharatiya Janata Party leader alleged that Congress leader Rahul Gandhi organised the event to provoke public disorder and exploit historical grievances, asserting that India operates strictly through constitutional mandates.
articles.description: Health Minister says Rahul Gandhi was ‘rubbing salt into the wounds of the Sikhs’ on the anniversary of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots

articles.headline: Vizhinjam International Seaport receives its first import container
articles.title: First import container arrives at Vizhinjam
articles.summary: The vessel MSC Sabrina III arrived at the Vizhinjam International Seaport carrying the facility's first import consignment since full-scale export-import operations began in August. The container of engineered building boards from Ningbo, China, was booked by BP2G Logistics and Ship Chandlers for M/s Alteir Group, enabling direct unloading and clearance to reduce transportation costs and delivery times for local entrepreneurs.

articles.headline: Brazil summons Argentina diplomat following Flavio Bolsonaro departure to United States
articles.title: Brazil summons Argentinian diplomat over Bolsonaro’s flight to US
articles.summary: Brazilian authorities summoned charge d'affaires Maria Emilia Cortes to address right-wing politician Flavio Bolsonaro fleeing the country after losing Sunday's presidential election. Bolsonaro faces money-laundering allegations involving Banco Master. He travelled through Argentina to Miami, declaring himself president-elect. The incident strains ties between President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Argentina's libertarian leader Javier Milei, who supported the departure.
articles.description: The move threatens to further strain relations between Brazilian President Lula and his Argentinian counterpart, Milei.

articles.headline: Amit Shah praises Chandigarh Police on its raising day
articles.title: Amit Shah lauds Chandigarh Police, says it set benchmarks for police forces across country
articles.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah lauded the Chandigarh Police on its sixtieth raising day, presenting the force with the President's Colour on November 1, 2026. Shah commended its six decades of service and announced the addition of one hundred forty-one new vehicles to enhance emergency response times, modern policing, and mobility across the northern region.
articles.description: Amit Shah was addressing a gathering on the occasion of the 60th Raising Day event of Chandigarh Police and presenting the President’s Colour to the force

articles.headline: Bulgarian voters cast ballots in presidential run-off amid Black Sea security tensions.
articles.title: Bulgarians vote in presidential run-off amid Black Sea tensions
articles.summary: Citizens are voting in a presidential run-off featuring incumbent Iliana Iotova and former caretaker Prime Minister Andrey Gyurov amid regional security threats. The election follows recent drone attacks on merchant ships off the Black Sea coast. Exit polls will follow the closure of voting at 8pm, with final results anticipated on Monday as candidates address the maritime crisis.
articles.description: Voters in Bulgaria weigh economic challenges and attacks on ships in a race marked by record low turnout.

articles.headline: Is China’s ‘dark tourism’ turning disaster education into entertainment?
articles.title: Is China’s ‘dark tourism’ turning disaster education into entertainment?
articles.description: China is seeing growing interest in ‘dark tourism’, where visitors flock to attractions that recreate natural disasters.

articles.headline: G20 family photo cancelled following European diplomatic boycott over Russia
articles.title: G20 'family photo' cancelled after protests over presence of Russian minister
articles.summary: Organisers cancelled the scheduled family photograph at the Group of Twenty foreign ministers meeting in Atlanta after European diplomats refused to stand alongside Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov. United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio hosted the gathering. British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband participated in the boycott, citing longstanding policies against direct engagement with Russian officials since the invasion of Ukraine.
articles.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband confronted his Russian counterpart at the meeting and accused his government of killing innocent civilians in Ukraine.

articles.headline: Yemeni forces seize military positions in al-Jawf
articles.title: Yemeni government forces seize strategic positions in al-Jawf
articles.summary: Yemen’s internationally recognised government reported that its forces recaptured military positions and strategic heights east of al-Hazm in al-Jawf governorate. The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs stated that more than 290,000 people have fled their homes since fighting escalated in August, while the ongoing siege of Taiz continues to severely restrict deliveries of essential food, fuel and medical supplies.
articles.description: Weapons and ammunition depots are seized after a counteroffensive.

articles.headline: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy criticizes Prime Minister Modi during a Delhi protest.
articles.title: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy likens PM Modi to ‘Ravana’ and Congress to ‘Vanara Sena’
articles.summary: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy addressed party workers at Telangana Bhavan in Delhi on November 1, 2026, ahead of an opposition rally at Ramlila Maidan. He criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi and alleged that millions of votes belonging to poor citizens were being deleted as part of a political conspiracy. Despite travel hurdles, numerous party functionaries gathered in the national capital to participate in the protest.
articles.description: Revanth Reddy likening PM Narendra Modi to Ravana, highlighted Congress cadre as ‘Vanara Sena’ as INDIA bloc stages protest against alleged SIR irregularities

articles.headline: Serbia changes government following years of protests
articles.title: From railway tragedy to gov’t change: Serbia’s two-year fight for justice
articles.summary: Serbia experienced a political shift after the Student List opposition movement won the October general election, following months of protests sparked by the collapse of a railway station canopy in Novi Sad that killed 16 people. Longtime leader Aleksandar Vucic resigned as president and pardoned prosecuted activists before his party conceded defeat in the election.
articles.description: A timeline of events since the deadly train station collapse in Novi Sad, which led to a change of government in Serbia.

articles.headline: Marc Marquez wins Malaysian Grand Prix in Sepang
articles.title: Marquez wins Malaysian Grand Prix to close in on retaining championship
articles.summary: MotoGP champion Marc Marquez won the Malaysian Grand Prix at the Sepang International Circuit, extending his championship lead to 44 points over absent rival Jorge Martin. KTM rider Pedro Acosta finished second and Gresini rider Alex Marquez took third place. The Ducati rider can secure his eighth title at the upcoming Qatar Grand Prix.
articles.description: Marc Marquez takes 44-point lead over Jorge Martin and can seal the MotoGP title in Qatar next weekend.

articles.headline: Israeli protesters urge Jewish-Arab coalition government
articles.title: Israeli protesters urge Jewish-Arab coalition government
articles.description: Israeli protesters urge Jewish-Arab coalition government

articles.headline: Four workers die in Ujjain hotel waste chamber
articles.title: Four die of suspected suffocation while cleaning waste chamber in Madhya Pradesh’s Ujjain hotel
articles.summary: Four workers died from suspected poisonous gas and suffocation after entering a food-waste tank at the Shri Ganga Hotel along the Ujjain-Dewas road in Madhya Pradesh. Ujjain Collector Roshan Kumar Singh and Superintendent of Police Pradeep Sharma confirmed that police and hotel staff recovered the bodies by breaking open the chamber following the incident.
articles.description: Two workers collapsed after entering the food-waste tank at Shri Ganga Hotel on the Ujjain-Dewas road; two more entered to rescue them, and all four died

articles.headline: Malawi cattle farmers travel farther for scarce river fodder
articles.title: Malawi cattle farmers travel farther as El Nino worsens drought
articles.summary: Malawi cattle farmers are travelling longer distances to find river grass as prolonged dry spells and El Nino impact southern Africa. In Mulanje, herders and fodder gatherers struggle with depleted vegetation, higher costs for maize bran, and competition from riverbank agriculture. Cooperatives report declining milk production and squeezed earnings as they await upcoming rains to restore pasture.
articles.description: For many families, keeping cattle alive is becoming an increasingly costly struggle.

articles.headline: Binance freezes half of funds stolen in record cyber attack
articles.title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has frozen roughly half of the six point three billion dollars stolen in a recent cyber heist. Co-chief executive officer Richard Teng stated the attack involved a self-destruct mechanism and multiple points of breach. Analytics firms and the United States Secret Service are working to trace the funds, while experts warn customers that promises to cover losses may not be legally binding.
articles.description: The cyber-attack, which the company describes as complex, is believed to be the largest ever of its kind.

articles.headline: Record spending drives competitive United States midterm Senate races
articles.title: Where are the most expensive midterm races and who is funding them?
articles.summary: Voters across the United States are preparing for the midterm elections on Tuesday, with control of Congress hinging on expensive Senate races in states like Texas, Ohio, and Michigan. Billionaire donors and political action committees have poured billions into the contests. Republicans have raised more overall, though polls suggest Democrats are favoured to control both chambers.
articles.description: Senate races in Texas, Michigan and Ohio rank among the most expensive in this year's midterm cycle.

articles.headline: Prominent Russian independent news outlet Novaya Gazeta announces its permanent shutdown.
articles.title: They strangled us, says founder of Russian newspaper shut under pressure from authorities
articles.summary: Novaya Gazeta, one of Russia's most high-profile independent news outlets, is shutting down after receiving an eviction order and having its reader donation system disabled by authorities. In a statement, the newspaper accused Russian special services and the repressive state apparatus of forcing it to stop operations. The closure marks the end of an era for fearless investigative journalism under increasing authoritarian pressure.
articles.description: Novaya Gazeta has been one of the most high-profile independent news outlets in Russia over the last three decades.

articles.headline: US appeals court rejects Trump bid to discard California ballots
articles.title: US appeals court again rejects Trump bid to set aside California ballots
articles.summary: An appeals court in the United States has rejected a petition from the administration of President Donald Trump to set aside 20,000 ballots in California over concerns about non-citizen voting. The ruling arrived on Friday, with less than four days until the November 3 midterm elections. Judges Mark Bennett and Gabriel Sanchez formed the majority, ruling the request violated the US Constitution.
articles.description: The 9th Circuit Court calls the petition to remove 20,000 ballots from California's vote count unconstitutional.

articles.headline: G20 drops group photo as Europeans refuse to stand with Lavrov
articles.title: G20 drops group photo as Europeans refuse to stand with Lavrov
articles.summary: The United States scrapped a traditional group photo of foreign ministers after European officials refused to be pictured alongside Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov in Atlanta. The move exposes deep rifts within the Group of 20, whose foreign ministers are meeting for talks overshadowed by ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and Iran. Russian state media reported that Lavrov arrived ahead of the discussions.
articles.description: Sanctioned Russian FM attends Atlanta talks as Iran war, Hormuz disruption and Ukraine divide G20 members.

articles.headline: US tech stocks fall sharply amid mounting concerns over artificial intelligence costs
articles.title: US tech stocks see sharp falls as AI spending nears $1tn
articles.summary: United States technology stocks dropped on Friday as financial markets reacted to escalating expenditures associated with artificial intelligence development. Major firms including Intel, Amazon, Alphabet, Reddit, and Roblox experienced notable share price declines following disappointing quarterly earnings reports and warnings about slowing sector growth and search revenue impacts, according to market analysts.
articles.description: Shares in Intel continue to fall while the tech-heavy Nasdaq opens at its lowest level in more than two months.

articles.headline: Supreme Court rules failed relationships cannot transform consensual sex into rape
articles.title: Failed relationships cannot turn consensual sex into rape: Supreme Court
articles.summary: The Supreme Court of India ruled on October 30, 2026, that women cannot retrospectively classify past consensual sexual acts as rape simply because a relationship has ended. Justice B.V. Nagarathna cautioned against the misuse of criminal laws in failed relationships from Kerala, emphasizing that genuine sexual assault cases must be vigorously pursued while preventing the justice system from becoming a tool of vengeance.
articles.description: Court distinguishes between consent allegedly obtained through deception and regret over consensual intimacy after a relationship ends

articles.headline: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic back new scraping opt-out
articles.title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
articles.summary: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic announced they will adopt a new standard allowing publishers to opt out of web scraping by artificial intelligence companies. Proposed by Kevin Kelley at the Internet Engineering Task Force, the shared policy token will live within a website's robots.txt file. Anthropic has already adopted the signal, while Google and Microsoft plan to support it next year.
articles.description: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI, as reported earlier by Search Engine Roundtable. With this control, publishers can apply their AI training preferences across multiple AI companies, instead of setting them individually. The shared "policy token" signal […]

articles.headline: Bangladesh forms new wage board to address garment worker protests
articles.title: Bangladesh forms wage board as garment workers protest
articles.summary: Authorities in Bangladesh established a six-member committee to determine a revised minimum wage following demonstrations that disrupted industrial hubs around Dhaka. Demonstrators demanded thirty thousand taka per month, citing soaring living costs. Meanwhile, Ministry of Labour and Employment adviser M Sakhawat Hossain Chowdhury urged employees to resume work as clashes with police injured several people near the capital.
articles.description: Demonstrations held in industrial cities as workers demand wage increase as cost of living rises.

articles.headline: Rubio hosts G20 talks as Russia’s Lavrov presence sparks tensions
articles.title: Rubio hosts G20 talks as Russia’s Lavrov presence sparks tensions
articles.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged G20 officials to work together to confront threats to the economic order.

articles.headline: Israeli protesters urge opposition to form coalition with Arab parties
articles.title: Israeli protesters demand opposition ally with Arab parties to oust Netanyahu
articles.summary: Hundreds of demonstrators gathered in Tel Aviv and Jerusalem to demand that Israeli opposition leaders ally with Arab-majority parties to remove Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from power following an inconclusive election. The proposed coalition could secure sixty-seven seats in parliament, although key opposition figures remain divided over accepting support from Arab factions amid ongoing regional security tensions and political disputes.
articles.description: Arab-majority parties made major gains in elections, fuelled by anger over rhetoric targeting the community from Mr. Netanyahu’s hard-right government, but opposition chief Gadi Eisenkot has not decided whether to seek a coalition with them

articles.headline: European Union and Canada launch Alliance for the Future
articles.title: EU and Canada seek deeper ties amid worsening global uncertainty
articles.summary: The European Union and Canada launched an Alliance for the Future in Montreal, where Prime Minister Mark Carney hosted European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa. The two sides signed a digital trade deal and announced measures to increase affordability and secure sovereignty. Carney also announced Canada's participation in a support loan for Kyiv.
articles.description: Both sides signed a digital trade deal, as Trump's trade threats push Washington's allies to seek closer ties elsewhere.

articles.headline: Supreme Court clears income tax assessments for former chief justice sons
articles.title: Supreme Court paves way for IT assessments of two businessmen sons of former CJI Y.K. Sabharwal
articles.summary: The Supreme Court dismissed four appeals filed by Chetan and Nitin Sabharwal, allowing income tax reassessment notices issued for assessment years 2008-09 and 2009-10. A bench comprising Justices J.B. Pardiwala and K. Vinod Chandran upheld that the tax department possessed valid reasons to investigate share transactions utilized to acquire a prime property on Delhi's Sikandra Road in 2010.
articles.description: A Bench of Justices J.B. Pardiwala and K. Vinod Chandran dismissed four appeals filed by Chetan and Nitin Sabharwal, while upholding income tax reassessment notices issued for assessment years 2008-09 and 2009-10

articles.headline: Serbia’s canopy collapse, two years on in a changed country
articles.title: Serbia’s canopy collapse, two years on in a changed country
articles.description: Two years after Novi Sad’s railway station canopy collapse, Serbia marks the second anniversary of the tragedy.

articles.headline: Donald Trump states Flavio Bolsonaro can remain in United States
articles.title: Donald Trump says Flavio Bolsonaro can stay in U.S. as long as he wants amid Brazilian probes
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump announced that defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro may remain in the country indefinitely. Speaking in Florida during a Halloween event, Trump criticized Brazil's recent election. Bolsonaro arrived under humanitarian parole following money laundering probes and the revocation of his passport, while U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio engaged with Brazilian diplomats.
articles.description: Flavio Bolsonaro’s decision to go to the U.S. followed a ruling by a Brazilian Supreme Court Justice to revoke his passport shortly after his loss, as the candidate faces a pair of federal money-laundering probes in Brazil and police there considered him a flight risk

articles.headline: Punjab activists demand justice following the murder of Parvinder Singh Jhota
articles.title: In Punjab, the highway to 2027
articles.summary: Protesters in Mansa town maintain a permanent sit-in camp on October 13 following the fatal shooting of anti-drug crusader Parvinder Singh Jhota. The forty-year-old activist was killed in broad daylight, leaving his last rites delayed by a fortnight as demonstrators demand action against the drug menace that has plagued the northern Indian state for over twenty years.
articles.description: The drug menace in Punjab has stayed at the centre of political and social attention over the past decade or more. With the killing of anti-drug crusader Parvinder Singh Jhota, public emotions are running high. Political parties are hoping to capitalise on this, with the Assembly election due in early 2027, finds Vikas Vasudeva

articles.headline: India marks 79 years of independence following map changes
articles.title: How were the States formed and how has the Indian map changed since 1947?
articles.summary: Following the Indian Independence Act of 1947 and the lapse of British paramountcy, India divided into two independent dominions and integrated numerous princely states. As India marks 79 years of independence, the country now contains 28 states and eight Union Territories after decades of internal boundary reorganisations driven by multiple factors.
articles.description: The last transformation of the Indian map happened in 2019 with the creation of the Union Territories of J&K and Ladakh

articles.headline: Supreme Court directs Election Commission to submit report on Form 7 misuse
articles.title: Supreme Court seeks report from ECI on Form 7 misuse allegations
articles.summary: The Supreme Court of India directed the Election Commission of India to investigate allegations regarding the fraudulent bulk filing of Form 7 applications for voter deletions during the Uttar Pradesh Special Intensive Revision. While responding to a petition filed by Congress Member of Parliament Tanuj Punia, the electoral body stated that although false forms were discovered, none of them were accepted. The bench ordered authorities to file a compliance report.

articles.headline: Portuguese police disperse housing protesters from Lisbon camp

articles.summary: Law enforcement officers equipped with shields and batons cleared a tent encampment in Lisbon following a large demonstration against controversial rental legislation. articles.headline: Depression over Bay of Bengal intensifies into deep depression

articles.summary: A weather system over the southeast Bay of Bengal developed into a deep depression by the early hours of November 1, 2026, according to the India Meteorological Department. articles.summary: Google has successfully generated its first response from space using an artificial intelligence chip-equipped satellite. articles.title: Canelo Alvarez defeats Christian Mbilli to reclaim WBC title in Riyadh
articles.summary: Saul Canelo Alvarez secured a 12-round decision victory over French fighter Christian Mbilli in Riyadh on Sunday to recapture his World Boxing Council super middleweight title. articles.description: Mexican boxing star wins 12-round decision to defeat the French fighter and regain the super middleweight belt.

articles.headline: Golden State Valkyries defeat Atlanta Dream to capture first WNBA crown

articles.description: Gabby Williams, named Most Valuable Player, sets records for most points (137) and most steals (18) in the WNBA Finals.

articles.headline: James Talarico challenges Republicans in costly Texas Senate race

articles.summary: Democratic candidate James Talarico is challenging Republicans in a high-stakes United States Senate race in Texas that has exceeded half a billion dollars in spending. Recent polls indicate a tight contest in the reliably red state, prompting visits from political figures including President Donald Trump. Strategists warn that a potential Democratic victory could significantly alter the political landscape both locally and nationally.
articles.description: The state's $500m Senate race may be the most closely watched in the US midterms, and is about far more than control of Congress.

articles.headline: Vatican confirms Pope Leo XIV cast mail-in ballot in US

articles.summary: The Holy See Press Office confirmed that Chicago-born Pope Leo XIV, formerly known as Robert Francis Prevost, has cast his vote in the United States midterm elections. articles.description: Does becoming the Pope automatically mean giving up American citizenship? Can a foreign head of state retain the right to vote in U.S. elections? How does Pope Leo XIV’s dual status as the sovereign of Vatican City and a US citizen affect his voting rights?

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh urban local body elections begin under tight security
articles.title: Urban local body elections begin in Andhra Pradesh
articles.summary: Voting for mayors, chairpersons, and ward members across 13 municipal corporations and 79 municipalities and Nagar Panchayats in Andhra Pradesh began at 7:00 am on November 1, 2026. articles.description: State Election Commissioner Anil Chandra Punetha and his team of officers are personally monitoring the conduct of the elections, for which elaborate arrangements were made, including the installation of CCTV cameras and deployment of drones at places where clashes are anticipated

articles.headline: Vehicles torched in Pulivendula hours before municipal elections begin
articles.title: Vehicles torched ahead of polls in Pulivendula
articles.summary: Several vehicles were set on fire in Pulivendula hours before municipal elections commenced on Saturday morning. Police reported that three cars, ten motorcycles, and a tractor were destroyed near Madhusudhan Reddy's orchard. Polling subsequently opened briskly amidst brief clashes and stone pelting between rival cadres, prompting law enforcement intervention across multiple wards in the town.
articles.description: The incident happened around midnight near the orchard belonging to Madhusudhan Reddy, where three cars, ten motorcycles and a tractor were fully burnt

articles.headline: Maharashtra FDA issues strict order to curb expired food sales
articles.title: Maharashtra FDA issues order to curb sale, repackaging of expired food items
articles.summary: The Food and Drug Administration has introduced a mandatory requirement for companies to provide proof of proper disposal and destruction certificates from approved facilities. According to FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe, recent state operations led to two registered cases and the seizure of adulterated goods worth five crore rupees. Authorities also cracked down on illegal activities in Bhiwandi and other regions.
articles.description: Speaking at a press conference in October 30, Mr. Mundhe says that instead of destroying stale and expired food items properly, they are being “disposed of only on paper.” These goods are brought back after being repacked by some agents and then sold to citizens. In some cases, even the production dates are being manipulated

articles.headline: Prime minister Modi highlights historic poverty decline citing World Bank report
articles.title: PM Modi cites World Bank report to highlight ‘historic’ fall in India’s extreme poverty
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted a World Bank report showing that India recorded one of the world's fastest poverty reductions, with 49.6 crore people moving out of poverty between 2011 and 2023. According to the October 2026 brief, extreme poverty plummeted from 27.1 percent to 2.6 percent, while employment grew by 13.4 crore in six years. Modi contrasted his administration's targeted efforts with past opposition campaigns during the announcement on Instagram.
articles.description: In a post on Instagram featuring the inspiring and energetic song ‘Thaan Liya’ from the Bollywood movie ‘Dasvi’ as background music, Mr. Modi highlighted that the “historic" drop in poverty represents a generational surge in opportunities
